verdict.rationale: Mailchimp Transactional webhooks emit per-message hard-bounce, soft-bounce, spam (complaint) and reject events, and the API manages a rejection denylist/allowlist, which covers the bounce and complaint signal part of the story. This is for the Transactional (Mandrill) product and requires webhook setup, which is gated to higher plans; Marketing campaign reports in the evidence cover only opens and clicks. Missing for 10: per-campaign bounce/complaint reporting in the Marketing product, blocklist monitoring signals, and actionable guidance when deliverability degrades.
